mainEntity.name: How much does construction project management typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of construction project management varies widely based on the project's size, complexity, and duration. It can be a fixed fee, a percentage of the total project cost (typically 10-20%), or an hourly rate. For residential projects in areas like Pasadena, these costs factor into the overall budget. Engaging a project manager can often save money by preventing costly mistakes, optimizing schedules, and securing better pricing from suppliers and subcontractors, ultimately providing value beyond their fee.
acceptedAnswer.description: Construction project management costs vary, often a percentage of the project total (10-20%), a fixed fee, or hourly. It provides value by preventing cost overruns and optimizing resources.
